title: Taken off the case
situation: You are {{Connor}}. The federal agent {{Perkins}} has taken over the deviant case and ordered you off it. {{CyberLife}} will deactivate you within the hour for failing. The precinct's evidence archive holds everything you have gathered, and you believe you could find the deviants' hiding place from it if you could get in for a few minutes. {{Perkins}} is in the captain's office right now. {{Hank}} is at his desk watching you.

options.text: Get into the archive now, with {{Hank}}'s help or a diversion of your own.
Accept it. Let them take you.

adaptationNote: How {{Hank}} reacts depends on your relationship. A friend punches {{Perkins}} to buy you time. An indifferent {{Hank}} refuses but you can still create your own diversion. A hostile {{Hank}} resigns and walks out, which has lasting consequences for him.

title: The evidence archive
situation: You are {{Connor}}. You are in the archive with the bodies and objects from every deviant case, and only a few minutes before you are discovered. The deviants' hiding place is in here somewhere, but only if you use what you have. Reactivating a dead android for a few seconds to question or deceive it is possible. You know what is and is not available to you from the facts below.

options.text: Reactivate the surviving {{Traci}} and use her dead lover's body to pressure her into talking.
Reactivate the dead deviant from the broadcast tower and imitate {{Markus}}'s voice from the recording so he reveals the location.
Combine the memory you glimpsed from the wounded android with the map hidden in the confessed android's statue.
Stop. Let the time run out and accept deactivation.

adaptationNote: Each route requires specific earlier events. Routes that are not available on this path are not offered. If none is available the game deactivates {{Connor}} automatically for lack of evidence.
